title: Profile NFTs - Incentivizing Social/Blockchain Engagement w/ Achievements & connecting Discord to Cardano

ms.promise:

We'll also create some designs that users can use later to customize their Profile NFTs, and some designs that users will see in the Discord when they earn an achievement.
Outputs:
・Discord bot connected to Profile NFTs technical specification.
・Designs for achievements, and for unlocks that users earn after leveling up

ms.promise:
This milestone will allow users that mint Profile NFTs on Cardano's preview network to start earning achievements for participating in community discussion on Discord, or engaging with the Cardano blockchain. These achievements can be completed from staking to a stakepool, sending transactions, using Staking Baskets, or helping new users in the Discord.

As they unlock these achievements they'll earn XP that allows them to level up their Profile NFT and unlock new Profile backgrounds. We'll also output a video that explains what achievements there are, how to unlock them, while demoing the site. We'll have to write code for each of these achievements that pulls data from Discord, and the Cardano blockchain. This code will update the XP for each Profile NFT as the actions are completed.
Outputs:
・Achievements mentioned in achievement outputs.
・Profile NFT XP for achievements unlocked.

Achievement outputs:
・Staking to a stakepool on Cardano's preview network.
・Sending ten transactions in the Atrium front-end on Cardano's preview network.
・Depositing ADA into the Staking Basket smart-contract.
・Reactions from Discord moderators in the Atrium server. Moderators can react with emojis t
ms.criteria:
This milestone should be accepted if users can mint a Profile NFT and start earning achievements on Cardano's testnet. These achievements need to be unlockable by using Discord, or Cardano's preview network. Users must earn XP from completing these achievements and unlock customization options for their Profile NFTs.
Acceptance Criteria:
・Users must be able to earn an achievement on their minted Profile NFT from preforming the following actions on Cardano's preview network

・Staking to a stakepool.
・Sending ten transactions on Cardano's preview network in the Atrium front-end.
・Depositing ADA

ms.promise:
This milestone will output a leveling system that goes up to at least ten levels on a publicly accessible website hooked up to Cardano's preview network. The leveling system is happening through users Profile NFTs that they can mint for free through the website. Each level users can unlock a background, or a level badge for completing achievements. This milestone will also output all of the branding images for the complete leveling system. These branding images will include over 15 unique customization options that users can unlock from leveling up and completing challenges.
Achievements included:
・Sending/receiving transactions.
・Joining the Discord server.
・Earning Mod Reactions.
・Reacting to other users in the Discord.
・Staking to a stakepool.
・Depositing 100k tADA into Staking Baskets
・Deposit 50k tADA to Diffusion with Atrium
・Deposit 200k tADA to Diffusion with Atrium
・Follow Atrium Lab on Twitter
ms.criteria:
For this milestone to be accepted, users need to be able to mint a Profile NFT and level it up to level ten by completing achievements. As they complete these achievements they need to earn XP that unlocks unique backgrounds. All of the unique backgrounds need to be submitted for acceptance. These achievements need to be from using the Cardano blockchain on testnet, Twitter, and Discord. Users also need to be able to update their Profile NFT to one of the new backgrounds they've unlocked.
